body: Since #2330, `ClimaComms.context` and `ClimaComms.device` throw a `TypeError` for every nonempty `FieldVector`, because the predicate `Base.Fix1(!isa, PointField)` evaluates `isa(PointField, value)`. They now return the context and device of the first `Field` at any nesting depth that is not a `PointField`, or else of the first `PointField`, and throw an error for a `FieldVector` without a `Field`. A new testset in `test/Fields/unit_field.jl` covers `PointField`s on another device, scalars, plain arrays and nested `FieldVector`s, and checks that `ClimaComms.device` infers its result type.
title: Correct the predicate that finds the context of a FieldVector
